remaining_concerns: Much of the positive record is still self-reported or programmatic rather than independently audited execution.
Security and anti-corruption gains are partly offset by ongoing conflict, corruption allegations around the governing network, and incomplete transparency reforms.
Several useful items are official or advisory rather than outcome evidence, so confidence should stay moderated by corroboration gaps.
